Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**THE RECORD BREAKER**

FADE IN:

INT. WORLD RECORD OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and camera crews. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, Please Welcome The Newest Record Holder!

Jasper Steps Up to the Microphone, a hint of a smile on his face.

JASPER
Thank You, Thank You. I'm Not Sure What's More Amazing, The Fact That I've Made It To 127 Or The Fact That I'm Still Standing.

The Room Erupts in Applause as Jasper Accepts the Plaque and a World Record Certificate.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper Lies in Bed, The Plaque On His Nightstand. He Looks Up At The Ceiling, A Faraway Look In His Eyes.

JASPER (V.O)
I Remember Reading About This Theory When I Was Young. Quantum Immortality. The Idea That In An Infinite Multiverse, Every Possible Outcome Exists. And I'm One Of The Lucky Ones.

Jasper's Voice Becomes More Urgent, His Words Spilling Out In A Rush.

JASPER (V.O)
What If I'm Not Just One Person? What If I'm A Branch In A Tree Of Possibilities? What If Every Decision I've Ever Made Has Created A New Reality?

Jasper's Voice Drops To A Whisper.

JASPER (V.O)
What If I'm The Only One Who Remembers? The Only One Who Knows The Truth?

The Camera Zooms In On Jasper's Face, His Eyes Wild With Fear.

JASPER (V.O)
I Don't Want To Die. I Don't Want To Leave This Reality Behind. I Want To Keep Living, Keep Exploring, Keep Discovering.

Jasper's Voice Becomes A Scream, Echoing Through The Room.

JASPER (V.O)
I'M NOT READY TO GO! I'M NOT READY TO LEAVE!

The Camera Zooms Out, Showing Jasper's Frantic Body, His Eyes Rolling Back In His Head.

FADE TO BLACK.

**THE END**
